zh-CN.title: 小程序顶部导航体验优化
items: 四个主页面的顶部导航在首屏保持透明，完整呈现页面背景
页面下滑后顶部导航会自动切换为不透明底色，避免内容穿透影响阅读

en.title: Improved mini program header behavior
items: Headers on all four main tabs now stay transparent at the top so page backgrounds remain visible
Headers automatically become opaque while scrolling to keep content from showing through
